routineAgentNotInRoom: The routine must be run by an AI teammate in this channel
routineEventScopeInvalid: The event scope can only be room or project
routineFeedbackBatch: feedback_batch is how many reports each run is handed: a whole number from 1 to {max}
routineFeedbackBatchPlatformOnly: Only a channel in a project that works on the platform itself can take feedback triage: teammates elsewhere cannot claim reports
routineFrequencyInvalid: The frequency can only be one of hourly, daily, weekly, monthly
routineInstructionsRequired: A routine has to say what it should do
routineManagerOnly: Only the routine's owner or a project admin can {what}
routineNeedsOwner: When Cheese creates a routine, it must say who it's for (owner_handle)
routineNoAgentInRoom: This channel has no AI teammate, so nobody can run the routine
routineNoNextRun: This schedule doesn't give a next run time
routineOnlyRunnerReports: Only the AI teammate running this routine can hand back its result
routineOwnerNotInChannel: {handle} isn't in this channel. A routine's results go only to someone in the channel
routineOwnerOrAdmin: “{title}” is a routine set up by {owner}; only they or a project admin can {what}
routinePauseActiveOnly: Only a running routine can be paused
routineResumePausedOnly: Only a paused routine can be resumed
routineStatusInvalid: status can only be succeeded or failed
routineTemplateGoalRequired: A template has to say what it should do
routineTriggerInvalid: The trigger can only be a schedule or one of the three project events
routinesRoomMemberOnly: Only members of this channel can see its routines
scheduleHourlyMinute: An hourly routine needs the minute to run at (0–59)
scheduleMonthlyDay: A monthly routine needs the day of the month (1–31)
scheduleTimeFormat: Write the time as HH:MM, e.g. 09:00
scheduleWeeklyDays: A weekly routine needs the days of the week (0 = Monday … 6 = Sunday)
routineResumeNeedsTrigger: Give it a trigger first — only then does it know when to run
assistantRoutineOnceAt: The run time must be within the next year, written like 2026-10-23T08:00
assistantRoutineTrigger: The trigger must be schedule, mention, review, due, invite, filed or decided
assistantRoutineAlreadyRan: This one-off automation has already run. Give it a new time to run it again.
assistantRoutineLimit: You can keep at most {max} one-off automations and as many repeating ones. Delete one you no longer use first.
assistantRoutineInRun: An automation cannot create or change automations while it runs
assistantRoutineWhichTask: Name the task (task), or use mine for the tasks the person asked for
